dataset.name: PA-EIS Evaluation Dataset - Phase 9A Expanded
dataset.description: Expanded RAG evaluation dataset (25 questions) based on PA-EIS (Priority-Aware Edge Inference Scheduling) IEEE paper. Includes original 10 questions from baseline benchmark plus 15 new questions for within-paper validation.

per_question_results.question: What is the main motivation for studying containerised Linux edge nodes?
What methodology does PA-EIS use?
What workloads are used for evaluation?
What are the reported evaluation results or metrics?
What limitations does the paper explicitly mention?
What Linux kernel features does PA-EIS rely on?
Why does the evaluation intentionally restrict CPU cores?
What container technology is used and what does it enable?
How does PA-EIS differ from traditional OS scheduling approaches?
What is the paper's stance on neural architecture search?
What is the Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS) and what problem does it create?
What are the three research questions (RQs) that PA-EIS addresses?
What is the layered architecture of the experimental edge node?
What is virtual runtime and how does CFS use it?
What hardware platform is used for the experiments?
Why doesn't the paper use accelerator hardware in its evaluation?
What metrics are used to evaluate inference latency?
What is the purpose of the parameter sweep in the evaluation?
What does PA-EIS stand for and what does it do?
What background tasks are used alongside inference workloads?
What is TFLite and why is it used?
What problem arises when edge inference runs on general-purpose operating systems?
What instrumentation tools are mentioned for measuring system behavior?
How many repetitions are performed per parameter point in the experiment?
What is the relationship between edge AI and data center inference mentioned in the paper?

notes: Dataset is limited to 10 questions on a single paper
Keyword matching is a lightweight signal, NOT semantic correctness
LLM latency may be variable due to free-tier OpenRouter model
Evaluation measures production pipeline without modifications
